tasks.short: Investigate accidents, injuries and occupational disease causes

steps.what: Investigate the actual event through site evidence, source records and interviews and capture each established fact with its source and time
inputs: Actual event and site conditions
Witness accounts and original records
Existing incident system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Engineer-captured source-linked facts, actual timestamps and unresolved contradictions

steps.what: Stage captured event fields into the investigation worksheet and sort explicitly recorded times into a source-linked timeline
inputs: Structured facts and timestamps actually captured in s1
Explicit field mapping and chronological sort
outputs: Staged facts and timeline with unknown times and conflicting accounts preserved

steps.what: Determine supported causes and preventive measures, evaluating contradictions and the limits of the investigation evidence
inputs: Actual source evidence
Staged timeline and unresolved facts
outputs: Engineer's causal findings and proposed preventive measures

steps.what: Write the actual investigation findings and check the complete report, causal reasoning, evidence links and proposed measures
inputs: Actual causal findings and measures from s3
Original sources and staged timeline
outputs: Complete checked investigation report with uncertainty and proposals distinguished

steps.what: Save the exact checked investigation report
inputs: Exact complete report checked in s4
outputs: Saved investigation report

tasks.design: Configure {OPS_SYSTEM} to stage engineer-captured facts and sort actual timestamps into a traceable timeline. The engineer investigates, determines causes and preventive measures and writes and checks the complete report before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual assembly can repeat evidence fields without helping causal reasoning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native incident fields and exact timestamp sorting can preserve evidence provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Witness conflicts, missing evidence and causal attribution require investigation judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a recorded sequence from a supported cause and choose proportionate preventive proposals.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: incident records can stage source-linked facts and sort recorded timestamps, while causal investigation remains expert work.

assumptions: Conditional investigation with actual manual worksheet/timeline assembly and an actual report; not a measured baseline. Witnesses and record owners supply original evidence, but engineer interviews, source checks and structured capture are fully counted in s1.
Native fields first. No free normalized incident feed or invented timestamp. Missing times, contradictions and ambiguous facts remain human work in s1 and s3.
Existing incident automation earns no new saving. s2 replaces only manual exact-field assembly and sorting; no causal model or automatic preventive instruction.

Report writing and the full final check remain in s4. Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. Implementing measures, issuing instructions or sending a regulatory report requires its own final-version approval and separate action, with labour added if in scope.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross assembly saving 20 less upkeep 3 gives net 17.
unknowns: Current incident-record fields and actual manual assembly effort
research_questions: Which facts are transcribed or reordered manually after existing incident-system features?

already_counted.description: Actual investigation and evidence capture, causal judgement, report writing and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain exact evidence mappings and test preservation of missing or conflicting times

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete investigation report checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual evidence-assembly saving 20 less upkeep 3; actual investigation, causal reasoning and report writing retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the actual product-safety research question, applicable evaluation method and required evidence
inputs: Actual product and research objective
Existing authoritative method and requirement sources
outputs: Engineer-authored research scope, method and explicit calculation definitions

steps.what: Conduct the actual research and collect and verify observations, existing test evidence and source data
inputs: Actual research scope and established method from s1
Actual product evidence and source publications
outputs: Engineer-captured source-linked research fields with units and limitations

steps.what: Import checked research fields and calculate explicitly defined descriptive evidence tables
inputs: Structured data captured in s2
Engineer-defined units, groups and formulas from s1
outputs: Traceable evidence tables with missing and incompatible fields held

steps.what: Interpret the research evidence and evaluate what safety levels it actually supports
inputs: Actual research evidence and traceable tables
outputs: Engineer's product-safety evaluation and limitations

steps.what: Write actual research findings and check the complete evaluation record and source/calculation traceability
inputs: Actual evaluation from s4
Original evidence and calculations
outputs: Complete checked research findings record

steps.what: Save the exact checked research findings
inputs: Exact complete record checked in s5
outputs: Saved safety research findings

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} imports and explicit formulas for engineer-captured research evidence. The engineer designs and conducts the research, evaluates safety and writes and checks the final {DOCS} findings before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated table assembly and arithmetic can consume effort within safety research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured imports and formulas can reproduce explicit comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Method validity, evidence quality and safety interpretation remain professional judgements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what the research can and cannot establish.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spreadsheet imports and explicit formulas can assemble research evidence without determining whether a product is safe.

assumptions: Representative documentary and existing-test-evidence research episode with actual manual tables and findings, not a measured baseline for every product study.
External authors and test owners produce original sources; engineer source selection, actual research and structured capture are in s1-s2. No free cleaned data or automatic safety classification.
Native tools first; existing equivalent tables and runtime earn no new saving. Missing units and incompatible methods remain human exceptions rather than normalized by inference.
No new physical test procedure or machine command is proposed. If conducting an actual new physical test is part of scope, include its readiness check, separate gated execution and full human effort.

Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. Saving findings does not certify a product or release it; any such action requires the appropriate owner to check the complete final version before a separate action.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 20 less upkeep 3 gives net 17. Deduplicate shared research and design-evaluation evidence if the same action.
unknowns: Actual research mix and current manual table assembly
research_questions: Which explicit research calculations are still performed manually after current tools?

already_counted.description: Research design, evidence collection/capture, safety interpretation and actual findings writing and final check

incremental.description: Maintain research import mappings and explicit formulas

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete research findings and tables checked in s5; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual evidence-table saving 20 minus upkeep 3; full research judgement and actual reporting retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual product design and determine applicable safety requirements and explicit checkable design fields
inputs: Current product design produced by designers
Actual requirement sources
Existing design review/CAD tool, defined as OTHER
outputs: Engineer-verified design version, applicable checks and captured fields with units

steps.what: Run exact design-field and numerical checks explicitly defined by the engineer in the existing review tool
inputs: Checked design fields and applicable explicit rules from s1
outputs: Traceable rule-check results and uncheckable fields, with no overall safety verdict

steps.what: Evaluate product design hazards, foreseeable use and check exceptions to determine the actual safety findings
inputs: Actual design and intended use
Traceable checks and original requirements
outputs: Engineer's design-safety findings and unresolved concerns

steps.what: Write actual design-review findings and check the complete evaluation record against the exact design version and evidence
inputs: Actual findings from s3
Original design, sources and check results
outputs: Complete checked design-safety evaluation

steps.what: Save the exact checked design-safety evaluation
inputs: Exact complete evaluation checked in s4
outputs: Saved evaluation for the actual design version

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} design-review checks for exact fields and engineer-selected rules. The engineer evaluates hazards and exceptions and writes and checks the full {DOCS} evaluation before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated explicit rule checks can consume attention within actual design review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native design checks can reproduce defined field comparisons with traceable results.
tasks.still_hard: Hazard identification and requirement applicability extend beyond explicit numerical checks.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise overlooked uses and limitations and evaluate the complete design.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native design-review tools can perform explicit field/rule checks, while hazard analysis and overall safety evaluation require engineering judgement.

assumptions: Conditional design review with actual repeated manual explicit checks, not a measured baseline. Designers produce the design; engineer applicability decisions, source checking and field capture are in s1.
Native configuration first; current checks earn no new saving. Ambiguous rules, missing units and unstructured geometry remain manual; no automatic legal applicability or safe-product verdict.
All hazard evaluation, actual review writing and complete final check remain. No design modification, product certification, release or notification is hidden behind saving.
Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. Shared evidence work with 21861 is counted once when identical.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross explicit-check saving 25 less upkeep 3 gives net 22.
unknowns: Actual design formats and native check coverage
research_questions: Which explicit comparisons are still manual, and which findings require contextual hazard judgement?

already_counted.description: Design and requirement verification, complete hazard evaluation and actual findings writing and final check

incremental.description: Maintain and validate engineer-defined checks as design schemas and requirements change

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete evaluation of the specified design version checked in s4; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual explicit-check saving 25 less upkeep 3; contextual hazard judgement and actual report work retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate and conduct worker safety training

steps.what: Determine actual training needs and prepare authorized material, capturing participant identifiers and the proposed session details
inputs: Actual worker training needs
Existing owner-maintained worker records
Current authorized training and equipment instructions
outputs: Engineer-prepared session material and captured participant/session fields

steps.what: Stage exact captured participant identifiers and session details into draft LMS enrolment and notice fields
inputs: Participant/session fields actually captured in s1
Explicit LMS field mapping
outputs: Draft session roster and notice with unmatched identifiers held

steps.what: Complete and check the exact final training notice, participant list, session details and material links
inputs: Draft session and notice from s2
Actual prepared material and training scope
outputs: Complete checked session notice and roster

steps.what: Commit the exact checked training session and participant roster in the existing LMS
inputs: Exact final session, roster and notice checked in s3
outputs: Saved training session and participant roster

steps.what: Send the exact checked training notice to the named internal workers
inputs: Exact final notice and participant list checked in s3
Actual session saved in s4
outputs: Sent training notice

steps.what: Conduct the actual safety training and observe worker attendance, questions and required equipment practice
inputs: Actual workers and prepared session material
Established training equipment and instructions
outputs: Actual training participation, observed practice and unresolved learning needs

steps.what: Capture actual attendance and observed required practice after training and check the complete completion entries
inputs: Actual attendance and observed practice from s5
outputs: Exact checked post-session completion entries, with incomplete participation marked

steps.what: Save the exact checked post-training completion entries
inputs: Exact complete entries checked in s6
outputs: Saved actual training completion status

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} draft-roster imports from engineer-captured participant fields. The engineer checks the final session notice before publishing it, conducts training and only then captures and checks actual completion entries before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual re-entry of participant and session fields can duplicate existing preparation work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native roster imports can stage exact identifiers and session details.
tasks.still_hard: Effective instruction and observed worker practice remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise misunderstandings and judge whether required practice actually occurred.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native LMS roster imports can reduce participant-field re-entry, while attendance and practice must be observed after actual training.

assumptions: Representative engineer-led training episode with actual roster re-entry, notices and required completion records; not a measured duty mix or invented records after an informal explanation.

Personnel owners maintain worker identifiers; engineer selection, participant/session capture and material preparation are fully counted in s1. Missing or ambiguous identifiers stay manual; no free cleaned roster.

Native LMS configuration first; existing imports and notices are baseline. Session commit and notice send are explicit separate retained actions, even if the native interface triggers both together; no saving is attributed to either consequence.
No completion entry uses attendance before s5. s6 records only actual participation and observed required practice; no inferred competence or automatic certification.
No generated safety procedure, new equipment operation instruction or regulatory claim. Material and instruction judgement remain human.
Both near-zero same-system actions are fully retained. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross exact-roster transfer saving 15 less upkeep 2 gives net 13.
unknowns: Current LMS import and notice behaviour and actual completion-record requirements
research_questions: Which participant/session fields are still re-entered manually after native LMS features?

already_counted.description: Preparation and participant capture, complete final session check and actual post-training capture/checking

incremental.description: Maintain native roster mappings and validate identifier handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact final session, notice and participant list checked in s3; changes require recheck
Exact post-training completion entries checked in s6 after actual participation; changes require recheck
Exact complete training notice and recipient list checked in s3 for the session saved in s4; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual participant-field transfer saving 15 less upkeep 2; actual teaching, notice action and completion evidence/checking retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Keep training notices and actual completion records in order
